summary.text: Ann Shippy is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 123, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Jeff Bradley (R) is also on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired Air Force colonel and longtime Hilton Head resident.

paragraphs.text: Shippy graduated from Riverside High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Pennsylvania State University in 1979 and a graduate degree from Regis University in 2001, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1979 to 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent over 28 years in the Air Force and in many leadership roles.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
In her survey, Shippy listed affordability, protecting rights and freedoms including free and fair elections, and smart growth that protects community character as campaign messages.
She said she would hold regular community meetings.
